ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows a food web, including plants such as grass, berries, and trees, as well as animals such as deer, reindeer, moose, rabbits, porcupines, foxes, and owls. The deer is located near the lower middle part of the picture; below the deer there are berries labeled “Berries”, and an arrow points from the direction of the berries to the deer, indicating that the deer feeds on plant-based food. Reasoning: In a food web, animals that eat plants or producers belong to herbivores. Because deer eat plant-source food such as berries, the deer represents a herbivore.
